about: The airframe's model for ArduPilot's simulator (spec: Simulator checks; sim/export.py). The model is the simulator's frame model (libraries/SITL/SIM_Frame.cpp, Frame::Model), written at standard sea-level air (ref_alt_m, ref_temp_c) so the file holds nothing about the site; the simulator then flies it in the air of whatever home it is given. The bluff-body drag is set through a reference test at ref_speed_ms, its angle solved so the simulator works out the measured areaCd. Full-pack voltage is MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX when it is set (the wiki's 'maximum voltage of your batteries'), else the cell count times full_cell_v for the battery chemistry (LiPo when the setup does not say). Parameters: the flight's set without the classes in drop_classes, without what the location policy removes, and without the groups in drop, each with why; the motor outputs move to the simulator's channels (motor n on output n), which is the only wiring the simulator's frame reads.

drop.why: ports, buses and board settings of the real flight controller; the simulator wires its own
the GNSS receivers' settings; the simulator brings its own receiver
how the real sensors are mounted and calibrated; the simulator's sensors are its own
how the real battery monitor is wired; the simulator measures its own battery
sensors and devices the simulator does not have unless they are set up in it
lights, cameras, gimbals, screens and ESC protocols the simulator does not drive
the output wiring: the motors move to the simulator's channels, and outputs left on those channels go

sources: the model's fields and how the simulator uses them: libraries/SITL/SIM_Frame.cpp (Frame::Model, Frame::load_frame_params, Frame::init: hover from hoverThrOut and the reference power, areaCd from refSpd, refAngle and mdrag_coef, inertia estimated from mass and diagonal_size when not given) and libraries/SITL/SIM_Motor.cpp (thrust in the square of the battery voltage over maxVoltage; momentum drag per motor of mdrag_coef times the square root of air density, rotor area and thrust) at Copter-4.7.0
air density at ref_alt_m: the 1976 standard atmosphere the simulator uses (AP_Baro::get_air_density_for_alt_amsl), 1.225 kg/m3 at sea level

full cell voltages: 4.2 V for LiPo (ArduPilot wiki, Copter, Setting up for tuning: MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX 'should be set to the maximum voltage of your batteries, e.g. 4.2v x No. Cells for standard LiPos, or as appropriate if using a different battery type'); LiHV 4.35 V, Li-ion 4.2 V and LiFePO4 3.65 V are those chemistries' usual charge-termination voltages

motor outputs: the simulator drives model motor n from output n (SIM_Motor::calculate_forces reads input.servos[motor_offset + servo]); ArduPilot's motor n is SERVOx_FUNCTION 33 + n - 1 for motors 1 to 8 and 82 + n - 9 for 9 to 12 (SRV_Channel.h)
